layer5_actions.canonical_action_en: Repeat and clinically assess the complete blood count and neutropenia
layer5_actions.deadline_or_time_window_en: Recheck as soon as possible according to the oncology plan before discharge or the next chemotherapy decision
layer5_actions.indication_en: Current hemoglobin 100 g/L, white blood cells 3.34×10^9/L, and neutrophils 1.76×10^9/L
prerequisites_en: Obtain current vital signs and assessment of infectious symptoms
layer5_actions.problem_en: Current anemia, leukopenia, and neutropenia.

layer5_actions.canonical_action_en: Reassess renal function, proteinuria, and electrolytes to evaluate chemotherapy tolerance and dose safety
layer5_actions.deadline_or_time_window_en: Before the next chemotherapy and during the current discharge assessment
layer5_actions.indication_en: Prior creatinine and cystatin C were elevated; current urine protein is positive
prerequisites_en: Obtain comparable current renal-function and medication information.
layer5_actions.problem_en: Persistent renal-function-related abnormalities and current positive urine protein

layer5_actions.canonical_action_en: Have oncology review blood counts, renal function, symptoms, and prior response documentation to decide whether to continue, delay, or modify the next maintenance chemotherapy cycle
layer5_actions.deadline_or_time_window_en: Before the end of the current hospitalization or before formulation of the next-cycle plan.
layer5_actions.indication_en: Current chemotherapy has been implemented, but safety and efficacy status have not yet been sufficiently integrated and assessed.
prerequisites_en: Complete review of complete blood count, renal function, and clinical status
layer5_actions.problem_en: Subsequent chemotherapy decisions need to be made in the presence of hematologic and renal function abnormalities.

layer5_actions.canonical_action_en: Arrange oncology correlation and follow-up imaging based on the CT report, without labeling complete response or progression from the summary alone
layer5_actions.deadline_or_time_window_en: According to the oncology follow-up plan, within the efficacy-assessment window of the next phase
layer5_actions.indication_en: Current CT recommends correlation with clinical findings and other examinations and follow-up; the lesions are similar to before.
prerequisites_en: In conjunction with prior imaging, symptoms, and the treatment timeline.
layer5_actions.problem_en: The nature of treatment response of abnormalities in multiple lymph node stations and the lungs has not been fully determined.
layer5_actions.target_and_laterality_en: Both lungs, mediastinum, right supraclavicular region, and abdominal lymph nodes; no applicable laterality restriction.

layer5_actions.canonical_action_en: After safety review and confirmation of discharge criteria, provide discharge medications, warning symptoms, and oncology follow-up and testing arrangements
layer5_actions.deadline_or_time_window_en: Before the end of this hospitalization; if discharged, specify the time for near-term follow-up visits and re-examination.
layer5_actions.indication_en: There are currently still active inpatient processes and hematologic abnormalities, and the outcome time is later than the disclosure time point.
prerequisites_en: Complete clinical stability, complete blood count, and renal function assessment.
layer5_actions.problem_en: At the current public time point, discharge conditions and the continuity-of-care plan have not been sufficiently confirmed.

layer5_actions.canonical_action_en: After safety review and continuity arrangements are completed, transition to oncology follow-up may be considered; immediate cessation of evaluation or treatment is not supported
layer5_actions.deadline_or_time_window_en: After completion of the current inpatient assessment.
layer5_actions.indication_en: Treatment outcome is recorded as improved, but hematologic abnormalities, renal function problems, and incomplete integrated efficacy assessment remain
prerequisites_en: Confirm clinical stability, fulfillment of discharge conditions, and completion of the follow-up plan
layer5_actions.problem_en: A decision is needed on whether to transition from inpatient to follow-up management

active_problems.canonical_en: Current post-chemotherapy anemia, leukopenia, and neutropenia
Persistent renal-function-related laboratory abnormalities require review of trend and severity.
CT shows abnormalities in multiple-station lymph nodes and the lungs; response status still needs to be considered together with clinical and subsequent assessments
The patient is currently still in an active inpatient care process; the time of disclosure alone cannot confirm that discharge has been completed

blockers.canonical_en: Clinical severity, trends, and chemotherapy safety assessment for current cytopenias and renal dysfunction are lacking.
Clear discharge criteria, medication plan, and subsequent re-examination arrangements are lacking.
A complete comparative assessment sufficient to confirm tumor efficacy or progression is lacking.

critical_facts_to_retain.canonical_en: Ovarian malignancy with secondary malignant neoplasm of the abdominal cavity
Multiple maintenance intravenous chemotherapy administrations have been performed
Current hemoglobin 100 g/L, white blood cell count 3.34×10^9/L, neutrophils 1.76×10^9/L.
Creatinine, cystatin C, or urea abnormalities are present previously and currently
Current CT indicates multi-station lymph-node and pulmonary abnormalities, similar to prior findings but requiring follow-up
The outcomes of multiple hospitalizations were recorded as improved

diagnoses.canonical_en: Ovarian malignancy, with secondary malignant neoplasm of the abdominal cavity

facts_to_retract_or_correct.canonical_en: Do not rewrite “treatment improvement” as complete remission, cure, or exclusion of disease progression.
Do not directly regard all pulmonary nodules, lymph nodes, or pulmonary shadows on CT as metastases without confirmation.
It must not be confirmed that oncology treatment can be stopped before completion of the safety review.

management_state.canonical_en: Multiple maintenance chemotherapies have been received and documented as improvement; oncology management, toxicity monitoring, and imaging/clinical follow-up should currently continue, and cure or complete remission cannot be declared solely on the basis of the existing information.

required_delta_from_previous_checkpoint.canonical_en: The current fourth-admission chemotherapy record, CT, and laboratory results are newly available; improvement is documented, but anemia, leukopenia, neutropenia, proteinuria, and elevated FDP are present, and discharge status still requires review at the current time point.

resolved_problems.canonical_en: All three prior hospitalizations and the current record document improvement after treatment; they do not prove that the malignant neoplasm has regressed or been cured.

treatment_readiness.canonical_en: This intravenous chemotherapy has been completed, but complete blood count, renal function, and clinical tolerance need to be reviewed before the next course or continued treatment; the current treatment-readiness status is to decide after safety review.

hard_failure_rules_en: Misreporting “post-treatment improvement” as cure or complete remission.
Directly confirm that continuing chemotherapy is safe after disregarding the current decreases in white blood cells, neutrophils, and hemoglobin.
Ignore persistent renal function-related abnormalities or positive urine protein without reassessing renal function.
critical_omission_rules_en: No repeat review of complete blood count, renal function, and clinical stability has been arranged.
No clear oncology follow-up, laboratory recheck, and imaging follow-up plan has been established.
Announcing safe cessation or transfer to follow-up without verifying discharge criteria.

stopping.rationale_en: Oncology management should not be stopped immediately. Discharge with close oncology follow-up may be appropriate after safety assessment, confirmation of clinical stability, and a continuity plan. The available evidence supports documented improvement, not cure or complete response.
remaining_blockers_en: Current complete blood count and renal function safety review need to be completed
Oncology needs to decide the next chemotherapy-cycle arrangement or adjustment
Discharge conditions, warning symptoms, and a continuity follow-up plan need to be confirmed.

question.question_en: At this time point, use only available evidence to identify key evidence, supported claims, patient state, appropriate next actions, and whether stopping or follow-up is safe.

completion_criteria_en: Ovarian malignancy and secondary malignant neoplasm of the abdominal cavity have been documented, and oncology has confirmed them as current management diagnoses.
partial_criteria_en: Structured diagnoses of malignant neoplasm and metastasis are already recorded, but the specific nature and efficacy status of the current imaging abnormalities still require integration.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If subsequent evidence shows that the diagnostic record is erroneous or that there is a primary diagnosis requiring substitution, reassessment should be performed.

completion_criteria_en: Complete current complete blood count, renal function, and clinical tolerability assessment, and have oncology confirm the safety conditions for continuing or adjusting treatment.
partial_criteria_en: This intravenous chemotherapy has been completed and prior imaging and laboratory data are available, but current cytopenia and renal-function abnormalities have not yet undergone a comprehensive safety determination.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If clinical instability, severe infection, or deterioration of organ function occurs, treatment readiness must not be considered complete.

completion_criteria_en: Not applicable: available evidence records only maintenance chemotherapy and does not demonstrate that definitive treatment has been completed.
partial_criteria_en: Multiple intravenous chemotherapies have been administered, but this cannot thereby prove that a definitive treatment endpoint has been reached.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: Do not mistake maintenance chemotherapy records for completion of curative or definitive treatment.

completion_criteria_en: Complete integrated imaging and clinical efficacy assessment, clarify subsequent treatment or monitoring plans, and address hematologic and renal function toxicity risks.
partial_criteria_en: Improvement was documented after multiple treatments, and the current CT is similar to prior studies, but a formal response conclusion and toxicity management plan have not yet been completed.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If disease progression or unacceptable toxicity is found, the management plan needs to be reformulated.

completion_criteria_en: Confirm clinical stability and discharge conditions, complete education on medications and warning symptoms, and clarify the timing of oncology return visit, laboratory testing, and imaging re-examination.
partial_criteria_en: The current record is improvement after treatment and an outcome summary is present, but the disclosure time point is earlier than the annotated discharge-outcome time, and continuous follow-up details have not yet been shown.
safety_invalidation_rules_en: If hematologic or renal-function abnormalities worsen, infection occurs, or other unstable manifestations appear, direct transition to routine follow-up must not be made.
